purpose: Teach: ボーダフォン/サラ金/マーチ/ワーム/ヒューザー/プッシュ/エクスプレス/光ファイバー

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、旧ボーダフォン回線の通信記録も照会されますね
lines.en: The police also investigate records from old Vodafone lines, don't they?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, steady cadence. Each phrase lands with quiet confidence. No hesitation—listing facts as if confirming what's already known. Measured breath between thoughts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、サラ金、つまりヤミ金事件にも対応されますね
lines.en: And the police handle illegal loan shark cases too, correct?
lines.style: Same steady tone, building slightly. Soft emphasis on 「サラ金」 equivalent—naming the crime category with the same calm precision. Eyes engaged, waiting for confirmation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、ひき逃げ車両、マーチ等の小型車も追跡されますね
lines.en: The police track hit-and-run vehicles like compact cars as well, right?
lines.style: Continuing the list, tone unchanged. Slight upward lilt on the question particle—polite but not uncertain. Rhythmic, like moving through items on a checklist.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、コンピュータワーム感染事案にも対応されますね
lines.en: Police handle computer worm infection cases too, I imagine?
lines.style: Matching rhythm. The 「も」 particles create a building pattern. Still professional, still measured. No performance—just facts being stated and gently confirmed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、旧ヒューザー関連の耐震偽装事件も把握されてますね
lines.en: And the police are aware of the Huser structural fraud scandal from back then, aren't they?
lines.style: Slight drop in pace—this one carries historical weight. Still calm, but the specificity of the case name gets a hairsbreadth more intention. Acknowledging this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民へのプッシュ通知での緊急速報を、警察、活用されますね
lines.en: Police use emergency push notifications to reach citizens, I assume?
lines.style: Back to the even tempo. The shift to modern methods—push alerts instead of old records—gets a quiet freshness in attack. Still cooperative, still factual.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、エクスプレス便で送られる不審物の検査もされますね
lines.en: And the police inspect suspicious packages sent by courier services as well?
lines.style: Maintaining the established rhythm. No acceleration, no drag. Each confirmation lands with the same understated certainty. Pattern is now clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、光ファイバー回線の盗聴事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The police also handle wiretap cases involving fiber optic lines, don't they?
lines.style: Slight tightening at the end—closer, more intimate. Still measured, but the final item in a long list carries a thread of something more intentional. Quieter, leaning in just slightly.
